sloka: हृता भार्या च मे तेन प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसी ।सुहृदः च मदीया ये संयता बन्धनेषु ते ॥४-८-३३॥
transliteration: hṛtā bhāryā ca me tena prāṇebhyo api garīyasī ।suhṛdaḥ ca madīyā ye saṁyatā bandhaneṣu te ॥4-8-33॥

translations.english: 'I was robbed of my wife who is dearer than my own life. All my friends were rounded up and imprisoned.
